acquisition_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent mode to automatically switch between MS and MS/MS acquisition.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The tryptic peptide samples were analyzed using an Ultimate 3000 nano-UHPLC system (Dionex, Sunnyvale, CA, USA) connected to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (ThermoElectron, Bremen, Germany) equipped with a nano electrospray ion source.

collision_energy.evidence: The method used allowed sequential isolation of up to the ten most intense ions, depending on signal intensity (intensity threshold 1.7e4), for fragmentation using higher-energy collision induced dissociation (HCD) at a target value of 10,000 charges and a resolution R = 17,500 with NCE 25 and NCE 35.
